# Resource: catalyst_stratus_object

Manage an object in an existing unversioned Stratus bucket. Uploads local bytes and content type, supports in-place content updates, import, SHA-256 drift detection and confirmed deletion. Files are limited to 100 MiB. Single upload is the default; multipart_part_size_mb opts into multipart transfers. Versioned keys and TTL are not supported. Owns the complete custom metadata map; removing entries clears them remotely. The key must belong exclusively to this resource and have no version history. Destroy permanently removes the managed key. Creation checks absence and uses overwrite=false; existing keys require explicit import. Temporary signatures remain in memory; transfers use the expected regional Stratus origin without OAuth headers. Source contents are not stored in state. Requires bucket read and object read/create/update/delete scopes; metadata updates need ZohoCatalyst.buckets.objects.UPDATE. Import as project_id/bucket_name/object_key, retaining nested slashes. Multipart transfer settings are local and must be supplied again after import. Incomplete sessions are reported with an upload ID; a public abort/resume lifecycle has not been established. Live validation is limited to India Development.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Existing Catalyst project ID."
}
variable "bucket_name" {
  type        = string
  description = "Existing unversioned Stratus bucket name."
}
variable "object_source" {
  type        = string
  description = "Path to an existing local file, up to 100 MB."
}
resource "catalyst_stratus_object" "example" {
  project_id    = var.project_id
  bucket_name   = var.bucket_name
  key           = "assets/example.bin"
  source        = var.object_source
  source_sha256 = filesha256(var.object_source)
  content_type  = "application/octet-stream"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Existing unversioned bucket's lowercase DNS name.
- `key` (String) Object key, up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Nested paths are supported; absolute paths, dot segments, control characters and backslashes are rejected.
- `project_id` (String) Existing project ID.
- `source` (String) Local regular file, up to 100 MB. Build or prepare it before applying.
- `source_sha256` (String) Lowercase hex SHA-256, usually filesha256(source). Refresh downloads bytes to detect changes independently of ETag.

### Optional

- `content_type` (String) Canonical MIME content type; defaults to application/octet-stream.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Complete custom metadata map. Keys/values use ASCII letters, digits, spaces, underscores and hyphens; total size is limited to 2047 characters including delimiters. Empty clears all metadata. Values remain in Terraform state; do not put secrets here.
- `multipart_part_size_mb` (Number) 0 (default) uses one upload; 5–20 opts into multipart uploads with that part size in MiB. The 100 MiB source limit still applies. Incomplete sessions are reported with their upload ID; no public abort contract is established. Changing this local transfer option reuploads the object.

## Attribute Reference

- `etag` (String) Opaque ETag returned by Stratus; source_sha256 verifies actual content.
- `id` (String) Composite project_id/bucket_name/object_key identity.
- `size` (Number) Remote object size in bytes.

## Import

Use the same provider data center, organization and environment as the existing
resource. Import reads the object into state; review the next plan before apply.

### Import Command

```shell
terraform import catalyst_stratus_object.example 'PROJECT_ID/BUCKET_NAME/assets/example.bin'
```
